propositions: tracked files with local working-tree deletions cause git merge to abort with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge', leaving reconverge unable to advance and stranding local ticket commits
a working-tree DELETION of a tracked file (status ` D`) must be restored via `git checkout -- <path>` to unblock the merge without data loss
a working-tree MODIFICATION of a tracked file must be copied to quarantine before restoration to preserve local bytes while allowing the merge to proceed
after recovery (restore and/or quarantine), the merge must be retried once; any subsequent failure keeps existing abort behavior and hints fsck-recover
the recovery mechanism must reuse the parse-and-retry pattern established in change 1757 for untracked-file overwrites, extending the same seam rather than adding a separate recovery path
